primary_sources.read_scope: Section 2.1, definitions and strictly triangular permutation representation
primary_sources.interface: Constructed polynomial permutation, not comparison acquisition

primary_sources.title: Learning conditionally lexicographic preference relations
primary_sources.read_scope: Primary author PDF search rendering: abstract, introduction and named binary-attribute model; detailed PDF open/find retries failed
primary_sources.interface: Chosen pair of visible multiattribute outcomes returns preference
primary_sources.finding: Close response type, visible attribute representation; hidden affine decoder recovery is not supplied by the inspected model
primary_sources.limits: Detailed communication-complexity formulas were not re-audited from this live retrieval

primary_sources.title: Noisy Interpolating Sets for Low-Degree Polynomials
primary_sources.read_scope: Pages 1-4: definition 1.1, theorem 1.2, corollary 1.3; multiset versus proper-set distinction
primary_sources.interface: Corrupted values of one known-degree polynomial on a constructed NIS
primary_sources.finding: Explicit O(n^d) families with efficient interpolation and constant error correction are prior; a base code is an additional component
primary_sources.limits: No claim the current executable instantiates the full asymptotic base-code family

primary_sources.title: List-Decoding Reed-Muller Codes over Small Fields
primary_sources.authors: Parikshit Gopalan, Adam R. Klivans, David Zuckerman
primary_sources.read_scope: Printed pages 2-3: majority unique radius, local adaptation and bypass of NIS through local majority logic
primary_sources.interface: Received-word value oracle; degree and distance promises
primary_sources.finding: Reed majority unique decoding below half the minimum distance is established; it does not acquire the comparator flag

primary_sources.title: Learning Combinatorial Functions from Pairwise Comparisons
primary_sources.read_scope: Section 2.2 and Section 5; approximate comparator model and nonlinear/Fourier-sparse families
primary_sources.interface: Pairwise comparisons of set-function values; distributional comparator prediction
primary_sources.finding: Strong same-response literature; inspected guarantees are approximate predictions on most pairs, not exact significance-ordered polynomial bijection recovery

primary_sources.title: Finding periods of Zhegalkin polynomials
primary_sources.interface: ANF coefficients supplied; output basis of all periods in n^{O(d)} time
primary_sources.finding: Period finding is established under supplied ANF access; comparator acquisition remains a separate reduction

primary_sources.title: Learning Decision Trees Using the Fourier Spectrum
primary_sources.read_scope: Official publisher abstract via live search rendering; direct page open timed out
primary_sources.interface: Membership values; Boolean decision trees with GF(2)-linear tests
primary_sources.finding: Exact bounded-depth identification polynomial in n and 2^depth is prior; a function of r linear forms has a depth-r tree
primary_sources.limits: The latter application is a direct representation inference; full proof and an implemented matched control were not audited

primary_sources.title: An Active Learning Algorithm for Ranking from Pairwise Preferences with an Almost Optimal Query Complexity
primary_sources.interface: Finite item set; arbitrary nontransitive pairwise preferences; approximate regret target
primary_sources.finding: Robust pairwise ranking is established, but the inspected target is approximate aggregate agreement, not exact hidden low-degree decoding
